Invariant naming reads only the callable __name__ or the declared invariant name attribute; these are the fixed fields used to identify one invariant in the finite explorer report.
Invariant descriptions read only the declared description field from the invariant object; an absent or newly selected field remains unresolved.
Invariant evaluation calls only the declared check field on the invariant object; the finite invariant contract owns this exact selector.
Candidate discovery reads only the finite project-neutral implementation-inventory protocol fields and never accepts them as authority.

The current serializer normalization iterates the fixed RuntimeTestResult dataclass field list; it cannot select an open runtime member and any new field changes the current contract and model identity.
The current leaf-evidence normalizer iterates the fixed RuntimeTestLeafEvidence field list; a new field or selector is a direct current-model change, not an implicitly compatible extension.
The current report normalizer iterates the fixed RuntimeTestEvidenceReport field list; the bounded protocol is explicit and any shape change must rebuild current authority.
Pytest adapter fallback reads only named fields from a plugin result object through a fixed read helper; mapping keys and accepted outcome fields remain validated by the native result contract.

Reservation plan reconciliation iterates one fixed field-to-field map declared in the current protocol; selectors cannot be supplied by callers, and adding a selector changes the current model contract.
